summary: Petrobras furnished a 6-K reporting its results in Brazil's ANP 4th Production Sharing and 6th Concession Permanent Offer Cycles. It won the Azurita and Cruzeiro do Sul blocks (100% each) with government profit-oil shares of 30.00% and 15.27%, and 19 Campos Basin blocks at 100% plus seven Cear Basin blocks at 70% alongside QatarEnergy (30%). Signature bonuses total R$3,219,251,245.60, payable by December 30, 2026. This is a routine licensing-round disclosure, not a special situation; no securities transaction, premium or shareholder vote is implicated.
